title: MCP Geo Layers Catalog
notes: This catalog maps user-friendly layer concepts to OS APIs and OS NGD OGC API Features collections.
Collection ids are versioned with a numeric suffix (for example trn-ntwk-roadlink-5).
Use os_features.collections.latestByBaseId to resolve the newest available version at runtime.
Clients should apply progressive disclosure: aggregate at low zoom, render individual features at high zoom.

examples: Heatmap from UPRN points for building density without cluttering cartography.
Line width is proportional to nearby building/UPRN density (computed client-side at high zoom).

layers.title: Postcode Unit Areas (NGD GB Postcodes)
notes: Added to OS NGD in the Spring 2026 release.
GB-only API Features layer; NI postcodes are not available through OS NGD API Features.

layers.title: Postcode Unit Points (NGD GB Postcodes)
notes: Added to OS NGD in the Spring 2026 release.
Use alongside postcode_unit_areas when both centroid-style and area geometry are useful.

layers.title: Bus Lanes (NGD Transport Network Bus Lane)
notes: Coverage is GB-wide from the OS NGD Spring 2026 release.

layers.title: Cycle Lanes (NGD Transport Network Cycle Lane)
notes: Coverage extends to Scotland and Wales from the OS NGD Spring 2026 release.
